nodes.label: GEMINI.md Global Context & Architecture Rules
nodes.rationale: Establishes global technological stack (Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1.1, React 19, Tailwind v4, Flyway), mandatory Spanish Javadoc, and ADRs.

nodes.label: JPA Entity Lombok Prohibition & Manual ID Equality
nodes.rationale: @Data, @ToString, and @EqualsAndHashCode are forbidden on JPA @Entity classes to prevent infinite loops on lazy relationships and Hibernate proxy issues; equals/hashCode must be implemented manually by ID.

nodes.label: Flyway Schema Governance & Hibernate Validate Mode
nodes.rationale: Uses spring-boot-starter-flyway with spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate so the application fails fast at startup if Java JPA entities diverge from versioned Flyway SQL migrations.
